row.rowText: Mortality Rate Attributed To Cardiovascular Disease, Cancer, Diabetes Or Chronic Respiratory Disease
row.footnote: Data pertain to Singapore residents (i.e. Singapore citizens and permanent residents) aged 30 - 70 years, and are derived from the Mortality Tabulation List of the International Classification of Diseases - Tenth Revision's ICD10 codes: I00-I99 (Cardio), C00-C97 (Cancer), E10-E14 (Diabetes) and J30-J98 (Chronic Respiratory Disease). Data are used for SDG 3.4.1 'Mortality rate attributed to cardiovascular disease, cancer, diabetes or chronic respiratory disease'.
